findings.message: `except BoxError` wraps the whole verb dispatch, so it catches every BoxError from any verb, not just unknown ids from triage, dismiss and prompt box. Every one of them now prints `-- name ids that chupa status lists` and exits 2. For example, a corrupt box file makes `chupa status`, `drain`, `run` or `serve` print `chupa status: invalid box file ... -- name ids that chupa status lists`. A RereportJournal conflict prints `conflicting reopen evidence; restore the journal-backed reopen signal -- name ids that chupa status lists`. Both point the operator at the wrong fix.
findings.paved_road: Give the unknown-id refusal only for unknown ids. One option: have `validate_ids` (and the box lookup in `ask.render`) catch the unknown-id BoxError and re-raise it as `runner.Refusal(f"unknown box id {id}", "name ids that chupa status lists")`. Then drop the blanket `except BoxError` from `main`, so other BoxErrors keep their old behavior.
